correctness.rationale: The Bessel kernel trace-class rank-one expansion is absolutely convergent for alpha>−1/2. Exterior-power Cauchy–Binet expansion has a unique leading index set for each m; trace-norm convergence justifies its operator norm and hence products of largest singular values. Dividing consecutive products yields s_n. Monic Jacobi squared norms give detG(n+1)/detG(n) and the stated constant. Q=cH² gives the exponent 4n+2alpha+2. Re-running the included high-precision check.py verifies twelve finite low-c ratios and the Gram polynomial identity; those finite checks are not the proof.
